_: U.S. presidential elections 1789–2024. Electoral College results: National Archives (1789–2020) and the American Presidency Project (UCSB); state-by-state returns (votes and electors) compiled via zonination/election-history for 1789–2016; for 2020 and 2024 the state popular vote is summed from the county-level compilation of the certified results at tonmcg/US_County_Level_Election_Results_08-24 and the electors are the 2010 and 2020 census apportionments. Geometry: Natural Earth 1:110m admin-1 (public domain).

elections.note: Unanimous among the electors who voted. New York appointed none; North Carolina and Rhode Island had not yet ratified.

The Era of Good Feelings: Monroe ran effectively unopposed.
No majority: the House elected Adams although Jackson led both the electoral and the popular vote.
